execution_scope: CPU FP64 interface check only; no installers or training launched by this file
isolation: Use the new v2 virtual environment and independent source checkouts; do not alter the old study environment

ncps.time_handling: Actual dt passed as timespans; explicit FP64 h0; dispatch one sample through official CfC at a time to avoid upstream squeeze broadcasting
ncps.verification: Require installed version; hash actual loaded module files. A version string alone does not certify equality to the reference commit.

spikingjelly.configuration: Recurrent width 4, learned tau initialized at 2, soft reset, detach_reset=true, step_mode=s, backend=torch
spikingjelly.time_handling: Event-indexed PLIF; real dt supplied in common input, no continuous-time neuron-decay claim
spikingjelly.training_limit: Four updates only check the interface. Report spike fraction; no claim that this is a sufficiently trained SNN.
spikingjelly.verification: Require installed version and record actual loaded source hashes; the reference is a release branch, not an asserted PyPI wheel commit.

s4d.configuration: Official minimal S4D-Lin, d_model=4, d_state=16, dropout=0, transposed=false; no fake DropoutNd or module stubs
s4d.time_handling: Event-indexed causal FFT convolution with real-dt input feature
s4d.identity: SSM/S4D-Lin; not Mamba, and not a replacement implementation labeled Mamba
s4d.state_limit: Upstream FFT forward returns no recurrent state; this adapter makes no streaming-state-memory claim

torch_adapters.attention: Causal TransformerEncoder: width 8, 2 heads, feedforward 32, one layer, dropout 0, sinusoidal event-position encoding, Boolean future mask
torch_adapters.verification: Record actual Torch version/git version and Python module hashes

installation_policy: Inspect existing v2 environment first. If using --no-deps for pinned official source installs, explicitly verify the selected CPU import path and record the installed packages. Missing imports remain blocked; never substitute a different model.
